S.PHON: ja tatuɾuaj satu tajratu i katajraan nira
S.FORM: ya tatoloay sato, tayrato i, katayraan nira,
S.PHON: ja tat[o|u]ɾ[o|u]aj sat[o|u] tajrat[o|u] i katajraan nira
S.TRANSL: 那三個人呢，要去他們的目的地。
The three went towards their destination.

S.FORM: mitafsiw, turira lalan, tuya pipitpitan nuya tamdaw, tu nasi.
S.PHON: mitafsiw turira ɾaɾan tuja pipitpitan nuja tamɬaw tu nasi
S.FORM: mitafsiw, torira lalan, toya pipitpitan noya tamdaw, to nasi.
S.PHON: mitafsiw t[o|u]rira ɾaɾan t[o|u]ja pipitpitan n[o|u]ja tam[ɬ|ɮ]aw t[o|u] nasi
S.TRANSL: 經過那條路，那個人在摘梨子的那一條路。
They went past the road where the person was plucking pears.

S.FORM: ma'pud kuya mipitpitay tu, nasi.
S.PHON: maʡpuɬ kuja mipitpitaj tu nasi
S.FORM: ma'pod koya mipitpitay to, nasi.
S.PHON: maʡp[o|u][ɬ|ɮ] k[o|u]ja mipitpitaj t[o|u] nasi
S.TRANSL: 摘水果的人下來。
The person who was plucking pears went down.

S.FORM: nengenghan nira, ccaytu kuya matumusay, a, langa, tu nasi. awaho ku paru niya ccay,
S.PHON: nəŋəŋħan nira ʦʦajtu kuja matumusaj a ɾaŋa tu nasi awaħo ku paru nija ʦʦaj
S.FORM: nengenghan nira, ccayto koya matomosay, a, langa, to nasi. awaho ko paro niya ccay,
S.PHON: nəŋəŋħan nira ʦʦajt[o|u] k[o|u]ja mat[o|u]m[o|u]saj a ɾaŋa t[o|u] nasi awaħ[o|u] k[o|u] par[o|u] nija ʦʦaj
S.TRANSL: 他看，只有一個籃子裝滿梨子，一個籃子沒有裝。
He saw only one basket was filled with pears, and one basket was not full.

S.FORM: icuwa satu kuya ccay, sa'an cingra a misaharaterateng.
S.PHON: iʦuwa satu kuja ʦʦaj saʡan ʦiŋra a misaħaratəratəŋ
S.FORM: icowa sato koya ccay, sa'an cingra a misaharaterateng.
S.PHON: iʦ[o|u]wa sat[o|u] k[o|u]ja ʦʦaj saʡan ʦiŋra a misaħaratəratəŋ
S.TRANSL: 一個籃子到哪去了呢？他不斷的想。
Where was one basket? He kept thinking.

S.FORM: ira kiya mitafsiway, tiya tatuluay, nengnenghan nira, awa ku ma'an nuya tatuluay,
S.PHON: ira kija mitafsiwaj tija tatuɾuaj nəŋnəŋħan nira awa ku maʡan nuja tatuɾuaj
S.FORM: ira kiya mitafsiway, tiya tatoloay, nengnenghan nira, awa ko ma'an noya tatoloay,
S.PHON: ira kija mitafsiwaj tija tat[o|u]ɾ[o|u]aj nəŋnəŋħan nira awa k[o|u] maʡan n[o|u]ja tat[o|u]ɾ[o|u]aj

S.TRANSL: 路過的那三個人，他一看，沒有什麼 。

TRANSL.notes: He found the three people who passed nothing (special).

S.TRANSL: He found the three people who passed nothing .

S.FORM: u mali, mitatuyan nangra, tafsiw sa'an kiya tatuluay.
S.PHON: u maɾi mitatujan naŋra tafsiw saʡan kija tatuɾuaj
S.FORM: o mali, mitatoyan nangra, tafsiw sa'an kiya tatoloay.
S.PHON: [o|u] maɾi mitat[o|u]jan naŋra tafsiw saʡan kija tat[o|u]ɾ[o|u]aj

S.TRANSL: 他們三個 拿著球經過。
They passed, carrying balls.

S.FORM: sa 'inga'ingaing, satu misaingiingir kuya, tamdaw, a minengneng tuya, nika awa nu ccay a, langa nuya, mipitpitan nira a, nasi.
S.PHON: sa ʡiŋaʡiŋaiŋ satu misaiŋiiŋir kuja tamɬaw a minəŋnəŋ tuja nika awa nu ʦʦaj a ɾaŋa nuja mipitpitan nira a nasi
S.FORM: sa 'inga'ingaing, sato misaingiingir koya, tamdaw, a minengneng toya, nika awa no ccay a, langa noya, mipitpitan nira a, nasi.
S.PHON: sa ʡiŋaʡiŋaiŋ sat[o|u] misaiŋiiŋir k[o|u]ja tam[ɬ|ɮ]aw a minəŋnəŋ t[o|u]ja nika awa n[o|u] ʦʦaj a ɾaŋa n[o|u]ja mipitpitan nira a nasi
S.TRANSL: 那個人搖頭，歪著頭，看著沒有裝梨子的籃子。
That person shook his head. His head was lopsided, looking at the basket which not was filled with pears.
